cz: 战至最后一刻，自刎归天
en: Fight to the last moment; accept death before surrender.
ch: 战至最后一刻，自刎归天

cz: 我的大斧早就饥渴难耐
en: My great axe has long thirsted for battle.
ch: 我的大斧早就饥渴难耐

cz: 不要愤怒，愤怒会降低我的智慧
en: Do not be angry; anger dulls my wisdom.
ch: 不要愤怒，愤怒会降低我的智慧

en: If he crosses the river; so will I.
Victorious troops grow proud; proud troops are defeated.

cz: 徐州城不愧是中原第一雄关
en: Xuzhou truly is the mightiest pass of the central plains.
ch: 徐州城不愧是中原第一雄关

en: I have my eye on your head.

cz: 堂堂吕布，为何成了三姓家奴
en: How did mighty Lu Bu become a slave of three surnames?
ch: 堂堂吕布，为何成了三姓家奴

en: His fate is unknown; that means he is dead.

cz: 我看你是舍不得这张帅案吧
en: You cannot bear to leave that command table.
ch: 我看你是舍不得这张帅案吧

cz: 此战将决定今后五百年的历史
en: This battle will decide the next five hundred years.
ch: 此战将决定今后五百年的历史

cz: 已经有了一次伏击，就绝不会再有第二次伏击
en: There was one ambush; there cannot possibly be another.
ch: 已经有了一次伏击，就绝不会再有第二次伏击

cz: 他马上会变出十万精兵来
en: He will conjure one hundred thousand elite troops at once.
ch: 他马上会变出十万精兵来

cz: 徐晃是我的韩信、白起、周亚夫
en: Xu Huang is my Han Xin; Bai Qi; and Zhou Yafu.
ch: 徐晃是我的韩信、白起、周亚夫

cz: 我部悍将刘三刀，三刀之内必斩吕布
en: My fierce general Liu Sandao will slay Lu Bu within three blows.
ch: 我部悍将刘三刀，三刀之内必斩吕布

cz: 我有上将潘凤，可斩华雄
en: I have General Pan Feng; he can slay Hua Xiong.
ch: 我有上将潘凤，可斩华雄

cz: 风从虎，云从龙，龙虎英雄傲苍穹
en: Wind follows the tiger; clouds follow the dragon; heroes tower over all.
ch: 风从虎，云从龙，龙虎英雄傲苍穹
